body.title: git_maintenance, git_setup, git_refs and git_reflog
body.summary: Add git_maintenance (gc, repack, prune, prune-packed, pack-refs, multi-pack-index, maintenance, commit-graph, backfill), git_setup (init, init-db, clone), git_refs (verify, migrate, optimize) and git_reflog (show, list, exists, expire, delete, write), with gc --prune=now, prune, reflog expire and delete as destructive and the rest common or none; init in an existing repository reports reinitialised true. Mark the rows covered with cases; only this Task's own rows are checked.
acceptanceChecks: Each op has a coverage case through executeTool in a temporary repository
gc with prune now, prune, reflog expire and reflog delete are destructive and denied with no client before git starts
git init in a repository reinitialises without loss and reports it
